subject: Biotechnology
title: Vertical Farming and Biotech
description: One-minute skill: Vertical Farming and Biotech.

hook.text: Stack crops in skyscrapers — vertical farms use 95% less water and zero pesticides. Biotech makes them better.

buildup.text: LED-tuned light spectra optimize photosynthesis — different wavelengths for leafy greens, herbs, and strawberries.

discovery.text: CRISPR-edited lettuce bred for compact growth and fast maturation thrives in vertical racks — optimized for the format.

twist.text: Energy costs remain the bottleneck — lighting consumes enormous electricity, limiting profitability to high-value crops.

climax.text: Biotech sensors monitor plant stress in real time — adjusting nutrients, humidity, and light automatically.

punchline.text: Farms without soil or sun — vertical agriculture reimagines where food grows.

quiz.question: What limits vertical farming's expansion to more crop types?
options: Crops cannot grow without natural sunlight
High energy costs for lighting make only high-value crops economically viable
Vertical farms cannot maintain consistent temperatures
